questions.question: Full-Mark Response Evaluate whether British values are genuinely shared across all communities in the UK. <div class="

points.text: A grade 9 response will: define the five British values; present evidence they are widely shared (legal framework, democratic participation, anti-discrimination law, education); present evidence they are contested (low voter turnout, institutional discrimination, extremism, social segregation); evaluate: values are aspirational rather than fully realised; conclude: British values provide a framework for diverse communities to coexist, but they must be actively promoted through education, law and democratic participation - they are not automatically shared but must be nurtured.
